result.topic_en: Calculation of the approximate date and circumstances of the next opposition (April 9, 1816) of a minor planet (apparently Juno) from its orbital elements, giving heliocentric and geocentric positions and the light intensity.

methods.what: Computation of mean longitude at epoch plus mean motion times elapsed days to get mean anomaly, then equation of centre to true longitude in orbit
Reduction from longitude in orbit (minus node) to heliocentric longitude and latitude using inclination (logarithmic computation)
Determination of opposition date by comparing heliocentric longitude of planet with Sun's longitude
Computation of brightness (light) as inverse squares of distances via logarithms
